subject: Prepaid burst conversion offer and execution path — temporary headroom request
participants_external: karen.li@brightmail.com (Karen Li, Head of Platform, BrightMail)
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen.li@brightmail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: salesops@brightmail.com
Date: 2025-11-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: short-term headroom for campaign surge

Evelyn —

Quick note from our side: we kicked off a marketing campaign last night and are seeing a 6x increase in inference volume for our personalization endpoint. Traffic spike looks like it will persist for ~36–48 hours. Current quota is exhausted; requests are being throttled.

We need a temporary uplift (target +150% above current quota) to avoid tailing errors for the campaign. Ideally this can be effective immediately and run until early Monday PST. We can accept a short-term overrun charge but would like to discuss converting usage into prepaid burst credits or a hybrid true-up to avoid heavy overage invoices.

Attached is a small export with today's hourly usage and projected token runway. Let me know whether you can enable headroom now and what the estimated incremental cost would be if we convert to prepaid burst credits afterward.

—Karen
BrightMail

Attachment: usage_report_nov_campaign.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@brightmail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-02T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term headroom for campaign surge

Karen — thanks for the heads-up and the export. I’ve looped in Karthik and Jordan to scope the pricing options. Two immediate operational items we can do now:

1) Enable a provisional +150% quota uplift (30m deploy) scoped to your project id — this will be charged at our standard overrun rate until we finalize an agreement.
2) If you’d prefer, we can convert the uplifted usage into a prepaid burst credit at a discounted blended rate post-facto and issue a single settlement invoice (reduces invoice noise).

Can you confirm expected total additional token volume over the next 48 hours (ballpark is fine) and whether you want us to enable headroom immediately? If yes, we’ll flip it and confirm ETA.

For transparency, we’ll provide a provisional invoice stub for the uplift so your finance team has visibility; I attached a draft provisional invoice.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: provisional_invoice_BR-7843.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karen Li <karen.li@brightmail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-02T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term headroom for campaign surge

Adding pricing context. Karen — quick proposals so we can move fast:

Option A — Emergency uplift (fastest): Enable +150% headroom now at standard overrun rate (1.6x published per-token rate). Post-campaign we invoice the overrun line-item.

Option B — Prepaid burst conversion (recommended if you expect repeat surges): Convert the uplifted usage into prepaid burst credits at a 12% discount to published overrun rate. We would: (1) enable headroom now; (2) after campaign confirm actual uplift usage; (3) issue a single settlement credit/invoice converting the overrun to prepaid credits at the discounted blended rate. This avoids multiple small invoices and reduces unit price. Requires a short amendment on billing terms.

Option C — Commit ladders: If BrightMail wants ongoing elasticity, we can discuss an add-on committed capacity for a 3–6 month window with lower unit price and burst buffer.

Operational note: we can enable Option B today and use a retroactive conversion process — we just need an email confirmation and the signed amendment within 5 business days to finalize accounting.

If you confirm Option B, I’ll send an amendment template and a DocuSign link.

—Karthik
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Karen Li <karen.li@brightmail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Urgent: short-term headroom for campaign surge

Thanks — Option B sounds good to us. We’ll take the prepaid burst conversion after the campaign if the discount applies as described. Please enable the +150% headroom now.

Estimated incremental tokens: ~320M tokens over the next 36 hours (see attached run); we’ll flag if that updates. We want a single settlement invoice and a credit memo reflecting the discounted conversion.

Can you get the amendment to us today? Our procurement lead is on standby.

—Karen
